About - 1st Source ABOUT US Built on a foundation of personal service, local connections, trusting relationships, and a commitment to the communities we serve. Excellence and Success since 1863 Since 1863, we've been providing our clients with convenient, secure, and personal banking. Our mission is Helping Our Clients Achieve Security, Build Wealth and Realize Their Dreams ® . Keeping Our Clients' Best Interests In Mind for the Long Term ® , we offer Straight Talk And Sound Advice ® to the communities we serve. 1st Source has grown to be the largest locally controlled financial institution headquartered in the northern Indiana-southwestern Michigan area, with $9.3 billion in assets and more than 1200 employees. We have banking centers in 19 counties, as well as several Trust and Wealth Advisory Service locations and 1st Source Insurance offices throughout the region to support the growing needs of our clients. Our business banking services help local businesses grow. Additionally, our Specialty Finance Group continues to propel us to be a leading financier in specialty finance with offices across the nation serving specialty groups like aircraft, construction equipment, long haul trucks, fleets, and much more. We believe so strongly in our mission that we offer financial education courses and aids at no charge to everyone regardless of being a client. This is through our dedicated 'You 1st' section on our website. Awards & Recognition National Regional BauerFinancial 5 Star “Superior” Rating The highest rating possible.
